post.summary: Upload and optimize one order photo or video
post.description: Requires evidence_type. Reception users may upload reception only; mechanics may upload work_progress only; admins may upload all three categories. Send one file per request (maximum 50 MB) and wait for its response before uploading the next file to preserve upload order. JPEG, PNG, and WebP images up to 40 megapixels are stored as compressed JPG with a maximum dimension of 1000 px and white background for transparency. MP4 and QuickTime videos are stored as H.264 MP4 with a maximum dimension of 1280 px. Processed files are stored in assets/evidence/{id_order}/ with a timestamp-based name and random collision-resistant suffix. The generated filename (without its path) is also appended, comma-separated, to work_orders.images or work_orders.videos, and the full path remains registered in order_evidence.file_url. Requires FFmpeg on the server PATH or configured via FFMPEG_BINARY.

patch.summary: Update public order status, budget fields, and parts decisions
patch.description: Uses the public order token to update the order status, existing writable work_orders columns whose names start with budget_, and/or parts decisions using UUIDs of existing items. Status must be one of received, diagnosing, awaiting_approval, approved, in_progress, ready, delivered, or cancelled (or null when allowed by the database column). The parts property only changes approvalStatus to accepted or rejected; it cannot replace the parts list or modify other item fields. Field names are resolved dynamically from the database schema; other order fields are not writable through this public operation. After commit, actual status changes emit order_status_changed, changed rejected parts emit budget_rejected, and a 0-to-1 budget_accepted transition emits budget_accepted. Accepted-budget alerts are deduplicated against an existing pending alert. Alert insertion errors are logged and do not roll back the order update.

parts.description: Unique UUIDs of existing work_orders.parts items and their customer decisions. Only approvalStatus is modified.

200.description: Status, budget fields, and/or parts decisions updated

post.summary: Save customer decisions for budget items
post.description: Updates accepted/rejected decisions for items belonging to the order identified by the public token. Positive numeric IDs (as integers or numeric strings) matching budget_items are updated there; any non-empty text ID matching an item in work_orders.parts is stored in parts[].approvalStatus. IDs are validated against the order and updates are atomic. Repeating an already-saved decision is idempotent; when at least one decision changes, the API emits budget_rejected if any submitted item was rejected, otherwise budget_accepted. Accepted-budget alerts are deduplicated against an existing pending alert. Alert insertion errors are logged and do not roll back the decision.

404.description: Order or item not found for this order
